title: txnbuild: time bounds above 2^63-1 parse as negative values, so a valid transaction cannot be rebuilt

target.versions_affected: v0.7.1 - v0.9.0 (executed on v0.7.1 and v0.9.0) and main 4cee0255 (lower bound not established)

severity_basis: Preconditions.FromXDR converts the uint64 TimePoint bounds to int64, so a bound of 2^63 or more parses as negative and TimeBounds.Validate refuses it ('maxTime cannot be negative'): a parsed transaction with such a bound cannot be rebuilt or edited through NewTransaction, and Timebounds() reports -1. A loud refusal; the transaction's hash and bytes are not affected.
caps_note: No CAP applies: TimeBounds and their uint64 TimePoint predate CAPs (CAP-21 later carried them unchanged into Preconditions).

entries.expected: a transaction with time bounds {0, 2^64-1} parsed with TransactionFromXDR is rebuilt by NewTransaction with the same bytes
entries.observed: No corpus entry rebuilds such a transaction in the Go column. By hand on v0.9.0: Timebounds() gives MaxTime -1 and NewTransaction fails with 'invalid timebound: maxTime cannot be negative'; pubnet ledger 60190078 holds such a transaction (7139913c…, protocol 24, successful).

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's standalone program on v0.9.0, main 4cee0255 and v0.7.1: XDR maxTime 18446744073709551615, tx.Timebounds() {MinTime:0 MaxTime:-1}, NewTransaction fails with 'invalid preconditions: invalid timebound: maxTime cannot be negative'.
evidence.expected_basis: TimePoint is a uint64 in the XDR definitions (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-xdr/blob/v30.0/Stellar-transaction.x) and stellar-core accepts any value; BuildXDR writes the same uint64 back.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 before filing on 2026-11-19: NewTransaction refuses the parsed time bounds.

queries: stellar/go-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01
stellar/go-stellar-sdk: the branches with commits since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6052; this record restates the public issue.
